faq.question: What does Likith do?
faq.answer: Likith Naidu Anumakonda is an AI/ML Engineer and the Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION. He builds applied AI/ML models, RAG assistants, computer vision tools, and full-stack web applications with Python (FastAPI), Node.js, React, and Next.js.

faq.question: What is Likith's education background?
faq.answer: Likith is currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) at Parvatha Reddy Babul Reddy Visvodaya Institute of Technology and Science (PBR VITS), Kavali, Andhra Pradesh, India. He also completed an Advanced AI/ML Specialization programme from IIT Patna (I-HUB).

faq.question: What creative work does Likith do?
faq.answer: Alongside software and AI engineering, Likith is a classical pianist and the author of the book "Echoes of an Unsaid Goodbye".

faq.question: What is RESOLVIT?
faq.answer: RESOLVIT is an AI-assisted civic issue tracking platform contributed for the GDG Solution Challenge 2026 (currently Under Evaluation). Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Leaflet, it supports citizens, NGOs, and civic authorities.

faq.question: Can Likith build AI agents and ML models?
faq.answer: Yes. Likith builds applied machine learning models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, and task-specific AI assistants in Python.

faq.question: Does Likith work with Python and Node.js web applications?
faq.answer: Yes. He builds backend services and full-stack web applications using Python (FastAPI/Flask) and Node.js (Express/Next.js) alongside React and Tailwind CSS.

faq.question: Does Likith handle APIs, databases, and deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. His experience covers REST APIs, authentication middleware, messaging/OTP workflows (Resend, Twilio), PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, domain/DNS configuration, Google Search Console setup, structured SEO metadata, and deployments on Vercel and Render.

faq.question: What is Likith's role in the Solution Challenge 2026?
faq.answer: Likith led Team SΛKRΛ in building RESOLVIT for the GDG Solution Challenge 2026 (currently Under Evaluation), coordinating AI workflow design and full-stack implementation.
